title: Focus Hack #1: where your phone goes during homework

copy.caption: Where does your phone go during homework? Another room is best, face down is okay, and you check it at your break. Out of reach is easier than willpower. Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.
